text_run.content: This operation creates a collection either with default or customized settings.

createCollection(CreateCollectionReq.builder()
    .databaseName(String databaseName)
    .collectionName(String collectionName)
    .description(String description)
    .dimension(Integer dimension)
    .primaryFieldName(String primaryFieldName)
    .idType(DataType idType)
    .maxLength(Integer maxLength)
    .vectorFieldName(String vectorFieldName)
    .metricType(String metricType)
    .autoID(Boolean autoID)
    .enableDynamicField(Boolean enableDynamicField)
    .numShards(Integer numShards)
    .collectionSchema(CollectionSchema collectionSchema)
    .indexParams(List<IndexParam> indexParams)
    .numPartitions(Integer numPartitions)
    .consistencyLevel(ConsistencyLevel consistencyLevel)
    .properties(final Map<String, String> properties)
    .build()
The name of the database. Defaults to the current database if not specified.
The name of the target collection.
A description of the collection. Defaults to
The dimension of the vector field.
The name of the primary key field. Defaults to
The data type of the primary key field. Defaults to
The maximum length for varchar fields. Defaults to
The name of the vector field. Defaults to
The metric type for vector similarity. Defaults to
Whether to auto-generate primary key values. Defaults to
Whether to enable the dynamic field. Defaults to
The number of shards for the collection. Defaults to
A CollectionSchema object defining the collection structure.
A list of IndexParam objects defining the index configuration. Defaults to
The number of partitions for the collection.
The consistency level for the operation. Defaults to
A map of collection properties. Defaults to
This exception will be raised when any error occurs during this operation.
